name: Oshawa Highway 2; reused Pickering–Mississauga
description: Number 94 was reused for a different corridor: the old Oshawa–Yorkdale Highway 2 bus ended in 2013; a new Pickering–Mississauga service began in 2020 and later incorporated Pearson Airport service.

timeline.event: The original route 94 timetable is Oshawa Highway 2, serving Oshawa GO, downtown Oshawa, Whitby, Ajax, Pickering, Scarborough, York Mills and Yorkdale.
Final day of the old Highway 2 route 94 before the Durham service restructuring.
First weekday service of the new route 94 Pickering–Square One, introduced in the September schedule changes.
Routes 34 and 94 were combined; the revised 94 includes Pearson Terminal 1 and Transitway stops.

gaps: The 2007 and 2020 number uses are separated by seven years and serve different corridors; they must not be connected as one continuous route.
Street-stop locations at Sheppard differ by direction; the schematic follows the westbound Yonge/Poyntz label.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
